# Import Liquid Meter Text File

 This function requires the Liquids add-on.

Use the Text File Import screen to bring in data from a text file that uses Quorum's text file format (contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a> for the file format). The file can be used to import liquid meter data for one or more meters.

<div class="procedure">

To import a liquid meter text file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Liquid Meter Text File**.

2.  Click the **Browse** button to locate a text file to import (example: C:\data\01301-July.txt), or type the file path into the **Import File** field.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 432;height: 144;" />

3.  If applicable, select **Meter number field is Import ID**. If you are importing data from a third party, and the meter number in the file is different from the meter number in FLOWCAL, you can set the third-party meter number as the import ID within the Meter Editor.

     If the meter number does not exist in FLOWCAL, the import will fail unless the Auto Create option has been enabled for text file imports. (See: [Service Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/Services/Service%20Configuration.md))

</div>

You can also use the File Import Service to import text files manually or automatically. (See: [Configure Imports](../../Admin%20Options/Configure%20Imports.md))

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.
